Bill URI is the IRI of the eli-dl:DraftLegislationWork instance; not an eli:LegalResource. No property needed — the IRI is the subject node.

Set :Bill on the Bill Work. :Bill is an eli:WorkType in eli:WorkTypeTable. Do not use eli:type_document: its LegalResource domain would reclassify the Bill. Act and related-document classification are unchanged.

The existing :BillDelivery eli-dl:LegislativeActivity produces this Bill Work through created_a_realization_of. Use the established delivery IRI derived from Bill URI and source methodURI; preserve the Bill Work and {bill-uri}#process identities. Applies to introduction, presentation and application/by-application delivery methods. Do not infer a date or a separate First Stage occurrence from this relationship. Missing or unsupported methodURI fails closed; there is no named-graph-only or direct Bill-to-process fallback.
Number component of the Bill process identifier (e.g. "60"). Range xsd:string. Applied only to the eli-dl:LegislativeProcess; the Bill Work carries the compound identifier through dct:identifier.
Combine billYear/billNo as xsd:string on the Bill Work; preserve the source components. Replaces eli:id_local whose Format/LegalExpression/LegalResource union domain is unsuitable for a Bill Work.
Year component of the bill identifier. Range xsd:integer (xsd:gYear ideal but outside OWL 2 DL datatype map). Applied to the eli-dl:DraftLegislationWork instance.

Human-readable string (e.g. "Enacted"); covered by statusURI. No separate mapping needed.

Explicit bill-status URI suffixes map to peer eli-dl:ProcessStatus individuals in :BillStatusTable: awaiting-signature→:AwaitingSignatureBill; current and published→:CurrentBill; defeated→:DefeatedBill; declared-repugnant-to-constitution→:DeclaredRepugnantToConstitutionBill; draft-heads-of-bill→:DraftHeadsOfBill; enacted→:EnactedBill; lapsed→:LapsedBill; rejected-at-referendum→:RejectedAtReferendumBill; withdrawn→:WithdrawnBill. The published alias is the API Current-state code, not a Published status; referendum rejection and Article 26 repugnancy remain distinct from defeat and event outcomes. Set on the eli-dl:LegislativeProcess; unknown suffixes fail closed.
Human-readable string ("Government" / "Private Member"); covered by sourceURI. No separate mapping needed.

IRI of the originating house individual (e.g. <.../house/dail>). Domain eli-dl:DraftLegislationWork; range agents:House. Distinct from eli-dl:was_submitted_by which carries the submitting agent.
Human-readable string ("Presented" / "Introduced" / "By Application"); covered by methodURI. No separate mapping needed.

Each amendmentList object is an eli-dl:AmendmentToDraftLegislationWork linked from the Bill Work via ELI core eli:has_part. The API provides no amendment-list identity URI, so derive Work, its Expression, and the tabling activity from stage, stageNo, date, chamber, amendment type, and a canonical signature of non-null formats.pdf.uri/formats.xml.uri pairs. Rendition URIs distinguish separate source records when base fields collide; they are source-record identity discriminators, not a claim that a rendition is the Work. Sort signature components deterministically; do not use showAs or array position. Exact duplicate mapped content collapses; conflicting mapped content for one complete identity fails closed. The source amendment-type URI selects the controlled :hasAmendmentListType individual; it is not a legislative ActivityType.

URI suffix maps explicitly: numberedList→:NumberedAmendmentList; unnumberedList→:UnnumberedAmendmentList; creamList→:CreamList. All are skos:Concept individuals from :AmendmentListTypeTable, set on the eli-dl:AmendmentToDraftLegislationWork instance. Unknown amendment type URIs fail closed.
Human-readable label on the agents:House named individual; not stored separately on the amendment list.
:inHouse links the amendment list activity to the agents:House (Dáil or Seanad) where the amendment was tabled.
Date of the amendment-list tabling eli-dl:LegislativeActivity. Range xsd:date. The amendment list itself is a separate Work.

URI of the PDF rendition. Validate through canonical source-IRI rules and include the format/URI pair in the amendment-list source-record identity signature. Attach the rendition to a deterministic Format embodied by the amendment-list Expression, not directly to the Work; the URI is an identity discriminator, not an ontological claim that the rendition is the Work. Format identity includes its Expression, controlled media type and rendition URI. Nested derived IRIs extend the parent's fragment; they must not contain multiple # characters. Represent media type using the object-resource semantics required by pinned ELI 1.5, not a MIME string literal.

URI of the XML rendition (null if not published). Validate through canonical source-IRI rules and include the format/URI pair in the amendment-list source-record identity signature when non-null. Attach to a deterministic Format embodied by the amendment-list Expression. Format identity includes its Expression, controlled media type and rendition URI. Nested derived IRIs extend the parent's fragment; they must not contain multiple # characters. Represent media type using the object-resource semantics required by pinned ELI 1.5.
Human-readable display label for the amendment list. Applied to the eli-dl:AmendmentToDraftLegislationWork instance.
Label on the linked stage LegislativeActivity; not stored separately on the amendment list.

Conditional mapping: when the source URI exactly identifies an emitted Bill stage (including the documented amendment-endpoint route alias), link the tabling activity to that occurrence's controlled eli-dl:ProcessStage, never to the occurrence IRI. For a structurally valid same-Bill route whose terminal stage code is exactly 6, map to :CreamListStage even if its concrete occurrence is absent; do not mint that occurrence. Other unmatched references remain source evidence and receive deterministic unresolved_source_reference diagnostics. Do not generalise the stage-6 rule to other numeric codes.

The source stage number within a single house at which the amendment list was tabled. Range xsd:positiveInteger. Applied to eli-dl:AmendmentToDraftLegislationWork; it does not replace the stage URI or independently determine the controlled stage identity.

Human-readable label on the agents:House named individual.
House in which the bill lifecycle event occurred. Set on the eli-dl:LegislativeActivity instance. May be null for cross-house events (e.g. Enacted).

Date(s) of the lifecycle event. Range xsd:date. Multiple dates indicate repeat occurrences (e.g. Published appears on initiation and on signing); canonical sorted unique dates contribute to event occurrence identity, independent of source-array order.

Only reviewed procedural event URIs map to controlled eli-dl:ActivityType individuals in :BillEventTable: published→:Published; enacted→:Enacted; bill-defeated→:BillDefeatedEvent; bill-lapsed→:BillLapsedEvent; bill-restored→:RestoreBill; bill-withdrawn→:BillWithdrawnEvent; recommittal→:RecommitBill; referendum→:Referendum; referral-to-supreme-court-art-26→:ReferralToSupremeCourtArt26. The referral concept is also the controlled ProcessStage for the matching Bill stage URI. These are event types, never occurrence-class instances, process statuses or outcomes. The source URIs admissibility-for-introduction, approved-for-initiation and other-procedural-event are intentionally not modelled: preserve source evidence, omit their event RDF and emit deterministic omission diagnostics. No other event URI is accepted by fallback.
Human-readable label for the lifecycle event. Applied to the eli-dl:LegislativeActivity instance.

Canonical source occurrence identifier/key; it is not necessarily the emitted RDF subject IRI. Derive every supported lifecycle-event occurrence from source event.uri, controlled eventURI type, normalized activity dates and chamber URI (including explicit null), using canonical SHA-256 derived-IRI machinery. Date order, showAs and source-array ordinal do not determine identity. Exact duplicate rows collapse; conflicting remaining mapped semantics for one complete identity fail closed.
House of the most recent stage; null for the final Enacted stage. Same mapping as stages[].event.chamber.uri.
Date(s) of the most recent stage activity. Same mapping as stages[].event.dates[].date.
HouseTerm in which the most recent stage occurred; null for the Enacted stage. Same mapping as stages[].event.house.uri.

Source-supplied positive integer giving the cross-house sequential order of the stage. It orders occurrences but does not identify or determine the controlled stage; stage identity comes from stageURI.
Human-readable stage name (e.g. "Enacted"). Applied to the LegislativeActivity instance.
ELI-DL 3.0 declares no activity-completion boolean predicate. Completion remains source evidence and latest completed activity is represented through eli-dl:latest_activity.

Preserved source evidence only. It does not set eli-dl:process_status or assert a BillEventOutcome; the Bill's controlled process status is mapped from bill.statusURI. Non-null source values include Enacted, Defeated, Current, Lapsed, Withdrawn, Rejected and Repugnant.

Exact source bill-stage definition suffixes map explicitly: 1→:FirstStage; 2→:SecondStage; 3→:CommitteeStage; 4→:ReportStage; 5→:FifthStage; 6→:CreamListStage; enacted→:Enacted; referendum→:Referendum; referral-to-supreme-court→:ReferralToSupremeCourtArt26. The Article 26 referral suffix shares the event URI's controlled individual. :Referendum is one individual typed as both eli-dl:ProcessStage and eli-dl:ActivityType, also used for the existing referendum lifecycle event. Each concrete stage occurrence uses its controlled individual for both had_activity_type and occured_at_stage. Resolve from stageURI, never progressStage; unknown or non-bill-stage definition URIs fail closed.
IRI of the stage eli-dl:LegislativeActivity instance. No property needed.

Canonical source URI identifies the Bill-owned related-document Work/grouping key. Retain one deterministic Work rooted as {source-uri}#work and link it from the Bill with eli:has_part. Derive one or more eli:LegalExpression IRIs from source URI, controlled docType, language, date and showAs; do not use the source URI directly as the Expression IRI or include rendition URIs in Expression identity.

Maps digest→:BillDigest; errata→:Errata; gluais→:Gluais; memo→:ExplanatoryMemo ResourceType individuals defined in legislation.owl.ttl. Apply to the source-keyed related-document Work, never to an Expression. A Work source URI cannot merge incompatible controlled types; such conflicts fail closed. Bill Digests are Bill-owned related-document Works/Expressions.
Publication date of the related document expression. Range xsd:date. Applied to the eli:LegalExpression instance.

Language of the related-document Expression. Map source codes such as "eng" / "mul" to controlled language IRIs compatible with pinned ELI 1.5; do not emit xsd:language/string literals for eli:language.
Human-readable label for the related document expression (e.g. "Explanatory Memorandum"). Applied to the eli:LegalExpression instance.

PDF rendition URI attached to its deterministic Format, embodied by the related-document Expression. Format identity includes the owning Expression, controlled media type and canonical rendition URI so multiple PDF renditions remain distinct. Represent media type using the object-resource semantics required by pinned ELI 1.5; do not emit application/pdf as a literal media-type value.

XML rendition URI (null if not published), attached to its deterministic Format, embodied by the related-document Expression. Format identity includes the owning Expression, controlled media type and canonical rendition URI so multiple XML renditions remain distinct. Represent media type using the object-resource semantics required by pinned ELI 1.5.
Human-readable sponsor name is source evidence only in Phase 4. Do not emit labels or descriptions on Member resources owned by Phase 3.

IRI of the sponsoring Member. The process links to deterministic Participation via the appropriate pinned ELI-DL participation relation; the Participation links to the Member with eli-dl:had_participant_person. Member is reference-only. Often null for Government bills identified only by role text.
Human-readable sponsor-role text (e.g. "Minister for Finance"). When no authoritative role IRI exists

notes: IRI of the specific ministerial role. Null in the Finance Bill record. When populated would point to a members:MinisterRole individual; role IRI pattern not yet defined. Deferred.

House in which this stage occurred. Set on the eli-dl:LegislativeActivity instance. May be null for the Enacted stage.

Source version identifier/key; it is not used directly as an RDF LegalExpression subject because the API may reuse it for distinct expressions. For docType bill, require this canonical source URI to be beneath its owning Bill IRI, then derive the Expression IRI from the source URI, version suffix, docType, lang, date, and showAs using canonical JSON SHA-256. Preserve the source URI in capture/evidence. Rendition URIs do not determine Expression identity. The suffix maps explicitly: initiated→:AsInitiated; ver_a→:VersionA; ver_b→:VersionB; ver_c→:VersionC; ver_d→:VersionD; ver_e→:VersionE; unknown suffixes fail closed. :VersionE is labelled from the reviewed source meaning, not inferred as a sixth printing.

For docType bill the parent Bill Work carries eli:work_type :Bill; the Expression does not carry a Work type. docType act remains deferred to Acts ETL; do not emit Act descriptions or Expressions. Enacted Acts remain separate eli:LegalResource resources referenced via eli:basis_for.
Date of this expression of the bill. Range xsd:date. Applied to the eli:LegalExpression instance.
Language of the Bill-version Expression. Map source code such as "eng" to a controlled language IRI compatible with pinned ELI 1.5; do not emit xsd:language/string literals for eli:language.
Human-readable label for the version (e.g. "As Initiated" / "As amended in Committee"). Applied to the eli:LegalExpression instance.
